categories.name: Administration
categories.description: Server configuration, security auditing, management tools, and administrative overrides.

commands.name: adminrole
commands.description: Configures or displays authorized administrative/bot developer roles for the bot override system.

commands.name: autoresponder
commands.description: Manage the server autoresponder processing matrix to catch and reply to message patterns.
commands.permissions: Base Admin Cog Level / Configuration Mod

commands.name: mediaonly
commands.description: Toggles an automated enforcement lock on a channel restricting text-only messages.

commands.name: permaudit
commands.description: Suite to check member permissions (/perm-check) or scan the entire server for high-risk accounts (/perm-scan).

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Bulk deletes messages matching standard filters from the current channel.

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Updates a member's server nickname or targets channel name profiles cleanly.

commands.name: role
commands.description: Utility system to assign or strip security and cosmetic roles from server members.

commands.name: setuplog
commands.description: Initializes or updates the text channel endpoint map for target mod logs.

commands.name: sticky
commands.description: Manage automated channel sticky message layouts via server slash commands.
examples: sticky set message: Read the rules channel: #general

commands.name: verification
commands.description: Links the core verified role database entry used by the verification gates.

commands.name: whois
commands.description: Generates a detailed profile inspection layout displaying join metrics, IDs, and roles.

categories.name: Channel Management
categories.description: Commands to adjust accessibility, clean up context visibility, or lock chats.

commands.name: hide
commands.description: Alters channel permissions to instantly mask or reveal it to the @everyone level.

commands.name: lockdown
commands.description: Freezes message execution updates across a single targeted channel.

commands.name: slowmode
commands.description: Adjusts or resets the active chat rate restriction loop using standard Discord intervals.

categories.name: Moderation
categories.description: Core punitive tracking systems used by the safety team.

commands.name: ban
commands.description: Permanently seals a member out of the guild space and triggers mod log dispatch.

commands.name: fakeban
commands.description: Simulates a user ban completely, sending an official direct message notice and structural channel warnings without enforcing a real ban.

commands.name: clearwarnings
commands.description: Wipes a member's entire moderation warning database index cleanly.

commands.name: delwarn
commands.description: Removes a specific warning infraction instance using its ID.

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Removes a member from the server safely.

commands.name: tempban
commands.description: Applies a temporary constraint loop on a user via isolation role.

commands.name: timeout
commands.description: Enforces a strict native communications restriction timeline lock.

commands.name: warn
commands.description: Issues a formal text warning penalization.

commands.name: warnings
commands.description: Retrieves the active list of history warning sequences.

categories.name: General Utility
categories.description: Standard user actions, configuration components, and metadata readers.

commands.name: afk
commands.description: Caches an AFK status block to automatically trigger back-references.

commands.name: avatar
commands.description: Generates a clear image embed block isolating a user's avatar.

commands.name: banner
commands.description: Extracts and displays a profile banner asset block.

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Measures heartbeat connection latency.

commands.name: serverinfo
commands.description: Generates a summary isolating vanity levels and member tallies.

commands.name: shards
commands.description: Audits internal cluster configurations.

commands.name: steal
commands.description: Copies a raw custom emoji payload to local guild assets.

categories.name: Voice Management
categories.description: Voice configuration actions used to manipulate room structures.

commands.name: drag
commands.description: Pulls a specific target member forcefully into your audio lounge.

commands.name: moveall
commands.description: Migrates every speaker into a targeted alternative room.

categories.name: System Help
categories.description: Hybrid commands usable across prefix styles and slash entry formats.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Launches the interactive modular interface menu.
